# Q-053: a bank statement's 2,720.00 USD deposit and three lines after it,
# each giving the deposit's cost basis. The first two are stated in US
# dollars as the bank writes them: 0.72 for 1.00 CAD, and 2,710.68 for
# 3,758.36 CAD, dollars that cost 3,778.15, so the second loses 19.79 that
# no split of it can record. The last, 8.60 USD, is written in CAD, the way
# the README says to state a sale in the book's own currency: the dollars at
# what their cost basis cost, 189557/136000, and the other split taking the
# `$residual$`. It is the last of the cost basis and is valued at its own
# cost, 11.99; the 19.79 is the second line's, and is not put on it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_deposit_linked_to_its_invoice_with_its_fee_restated_in_one_file.py.
